source.name: TKO Group Holdings - HE Turki Alalshikh and TKO Announce Launch of New Boxing Promotion in Partnership with Sela
source.note: Multi-year partnership among Turki Alalshikh, TKO and Sela ('A Public Investment Fund (PIF) company, Sela'); TKO serves as managing partner. No equity split in the release. TKO president Mark Shapiro later confirmed on an earnings call that 'TKO's Zuffa Boxing and Saudi Arabia's SELA will be the promoters' of Fury vs. Makhmudov (Boxing Social, 26 Feb 2026).

note: Sela's role spans promoter (co-promoter of the 11 Apr 2026 Fury-Makhmudov card at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium) and majority owner (reported 60%) of Zuffa Boxing. Same relationship is recorded as ufc-sela-zuffa-boxing under league 'ufc' because the venture is TKO's; kept here for the boxing target - the orchestrator may want to merge or cross-reference to avoid double counting.
